origin.semantics: Metrecept (iwasinnam2 / Ivan Karpusheff) — six-questions answer 2026-10-12, the replay vector: 'the fill and the replay of the same request, from two planes, with equal request and response digests, and a changed payload alongside with its own digests. That is cost-preservation stated as bytes: a replay is the same answer, and the record proves it rather than asserts it.' Wording and fixture: Verovo.

claim_boundary: Synthetic fixture authored by Verovo for conformance use. Not a Metrecept production artifact, not an endorsement, not an external reproduction.

published_rules.canonical_json: sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false — digests are sha256 over this form
published_rules.stream_assembly: a streamed response body is the concatenation of its text deltas in emission order; the digest is taken over the assembled body (the published assembly rule)

ledger_note: rp-001 and rp-002 are two distinct metered crossings (distinct meter_event_id) whose payloads are byte-provably the same answer; rp-003 is a different request with its own digests.
